observations.artifact_atomicity: Immutable SQLite BLOB, receipt and event support same transaction; no disk rename/orphan sweeper needed
observations.failed_consumers: claim selects queued only; recover selects running Attempt only. Dedicated terminal unverified will not be recovered automatically. UI generic failed label needs exact host reason mapping.
observations.legacy_fail: fail(unverified) can requeue or waiting_input; not valid terminal preview path
observations.reference_stop: _invalidate_source excludes terminal Goals, checks revision sources and running Attempt manifests. Waiting incidental source coverage is absent. Historic artifact read has no usability gate; retained-human-inspect must not be silently redefined.
observations.completion: complete verifies active Attempt, matching receipt, UTF8/hash/size, then emits goal.completed; role fence absent
observations.answer_binding: baseline input binds question_id/epoch but has no persisted question row or revision-bound answer-source metadata; latest-goal runtime routing is ambiguous for multiple waiting Goals
